On this week's Jeopardy, the first contestant was a construction worker, the second contestant was a physician, and the third contestant's profession wasn't revealed. The physician quickly outpaced both of the other contestants, and the construction worker did the worst, only getting two questions right. Who lost Jeopardy?
A. The construction worker
B. The physician
C. Can't answer
